purpose: Freeze before the held-out test run on C06-C15 (71 questions, 2 access probes). The code, evaluation set and protocol hashed here are the ones of dev-run-3 and of public commit 5fe88d0. No change after this freeze; a bug found during the test run is reported, not fixed in the same run.

final_settings.variant_order: rotated at each repeat, as the protocol states
final_settings.ollama: GPU hidden (CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=-1, Vulkan off), num_gpu 0 and keep_alive 0 on every call, one request at a time
final_settings.reranker: BAAI/bge-reranker-v2-m3 at revision 953dc6f6f85a1b2dbfca4c34a2796e7dde08d41e, on the CPU, fp32

change_from_development_record.change: Repeats on the test split: 3, not the 1 written in development-changes.json
change_from_development_record.reason: protocol.json, written before any run, sets 3 repeats per variant on the test split. The protocol prevails. On the CPU with temperature 0 the repeats are expected to give nearly identical outcomes; they measure run-to-run variation, not sampling variety.

development_changes: Listed in development-changes.json of the same folder; all were made on C01-C05 only.
test_cases_never_run_before: C06-C15 have never been run by any variant before this freeze.
